structural_change: w14 FALLBACK (STW-S81c-COLLA3-LEP 10-22) for lep_mu_h CRED12/DR12 (die-matching: mu72 lepe_mu_72 instantiates CRED 12 DR 12 RX_SRAM/IN_PIPE/NATIVE32 1). Classified r7m/r8m --cts gate (TT placement RC): A macro->reg 188 paths -141 ps = RX SRAM rd_out + fwd mux + 800-850 um wire to the N-face ml_wd capture; B reg->reg 77 paths -128 ps = W-face dq -> rx_control -> registered selects sa/sm/ta_r at the E side (968 um, one cycle); C 110 paths -114 ps = E-side frame slice pk_r/ph_r -> tx_push -> wr_group -> TX wp_r/count_r/valid_r (545 um + 6 levels); D f_host/fh_v -70/-72 (RX SRAM -> S face 560 um); c12f routed TT -235 = A + ~250 vq fan-out paths. Fix (opt-in defines, defaults byte-identical): WRLY = each SRAM head byte captured in a kept relay flop placed by OT_RELAY_PLACE at 0.15 of the macro->ml_wd pin line, then a registered hop to the N-face capture (+1 BOOKED edge on ml_wv/ml_wd only); SELST = the six delivery selects per rid group in one kept owner stationed at x 324 (between rx_control and the E-face rid owners); PUSHREP = kept replica of the frame pending state per push group/lane (same inputs/reset/edges; only loads = tx_push), VQREP = kept vq copies for rx_control / host enables; FHLA = fh_v from a kept copy of the registered host-enable lookahead. Same outline/macros/pins/clock spine as c12m (648x604.8). Lockstep eq vs current RTL (+1 on ml_w* only) + lepmuh bench (+1 landed) + mutants.
